# National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI)

> NCBI provides comprehensive databases and tools for accessing, searching, and analyzing biological sequence data, genetic variations, and biomedical literature.

NCBI is a premier resource for biological and genetic data, offering integrated access to major databases like GenBank, dbSNP, and RefSeq. The organization maintains extensive FTP repositories and web interfaces for researchers to download and query genomic sequences, SNP variations, and related biological information.

## Key Topics

- GenBank
- dbSNP
- SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism)
- RefSeq
- BLAST
- Sequence Database
- Genetic Variation
- Genomic Data
- ASN.1 Format
- RefSNP
- Allele Frequency
- Variant Annotation
- Biological Data Download
- FTP Repository
- eUtils API

## Genetic Variation Databases

- [dbSNP - SNP Database](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/snp/): dbSNP genetic variation database for human SNPs and genomic mapping with SNP search, allele frequency data, and variant annotation

## Sequence Data Repositories

- [NCBI ASN.1 GenBank Files](https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ncbi-asn1/): FTP repository of NCBI GenBank ASN.1 sequence database files for nucleotide sequences and compressed biological data archives
- [BLAST Database Repository](https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/db/): BLAST sequence database repository with genomic and ribosomal RNA data for sequence alignment and comparison

## Legacy Resources

- [HapMap Legacy Resource](https://hapmap.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/): HapMap legacy resource retirement announcement with migration to 1000 Genomes Project
